EmailTemplate.description: Post-deposit, take your next steps: orientation, housing, devil2devil, FAFSA, scholarship portal
EmailTemplate.name: FTF New Deposit
EmailTemplate.subject: Thanks for paying your deposit. Welcome to the Sun Devil family!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for paying your enrollment deposit. Here are your next steps toward becoming an official Sun Devil!
Next steps in My ASU (https://my.asu.edu)
- Register for orientation (https://eoss.asu.edu/orientation) as soon as possible to get your preferred class schedule. Program dates are based on the college of your major and fill up fast. - Confirm your housing preferences (https://housing.asu.edu/). All freshmen are expected to live in the Residential College of their major. - Join devil2devil (https://students.asu.edu/devil2devil), ASU’s admitted student network, to connect with your classmates.
Next steps for scholarships and financial aid
- Submit your FAFSA (Free Application for Federal Student Aid) to qualify for financial aid at https://fafsa.ed.gov/, if you haven’t already. - Apply for additional scholarships through our scholarship portal at https://scholarships.asu.edu/.
If you have any questions, please feel free to let me know.
Go Devils!
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
